description: Add CLI (agentwork/cli.py), WebSocket support (agentwork/server/websocket.py), Database Persistence (agentwork/persistence/), Observability (agentwork/observability/), and Rate Limiting (agentwork/server/rate_limiter.py).
steps: Create agentwork/cli.py using argparse with subcommands: 'run <company-type> <task>' (creates company orchestrator and runs a task), 'list-companies' (prints available company templates), 'list-tools <company-type>' (prints tools for that company type), 'serve <company-type>' (starts HTTP server with uvicorn). Company types map to the COMPANY_FACTORIES in TeamFactory. The main() function is the entry point. Add [project.scripts] agentwork = 'agentwork.cli:main' to pyproject.toml.

Create agentwork/server/websocket.py with WebSocket endpoint support: WebSocketManager class that manages connected clients. Methods: connect(websocket, task_id: Optional[str] = None), disconnect(websocket), broadcast(event: dict), send_to_task(task_id: str, event: dict). Function add_websocket_routes(app: FastAPI) adds a /ws endpoint. Clients can send {"subscribe": "task_id"} to subscribe to specific task events. Uses FastAPI's WebSocket support (optional dependency like rest of server).

Create agentwork/persistence/backend.py with abstract StorageBackend class (ABC): save_result(task_id: str, result: dict), get_result(task_id: str) -> Optional[dict], list_results(limit: int = 100, offset: int = 0) -> List[dict], save_knowledge(key: str, value: Any), get_knowledge(key: str) -> Optional[Any], delete_result(task_id: str) -> bool.

Create agentwork/persistence/sqlite_backend.py with SQLiteBackend(StorageBackend): uses sqlite3 stdlib, constructor takes db_path (str, default=':memory:'). Creates tables on init (task_results, knowledge_entries with created_at timestamps). Implements all abstract methods. Includes migrate() method that checks schema version and applies migrations.

Create agentwork/observability/logger.py with StructuredLogger class: wraps logging module, outputs JSON-formatted log entries with timestamp, level, message, trace_id, span_id, and extra fields. Methods: info/warning/error/debug that accept message + **kwargs for structured fields. Class method: get_logger(name: str) -> StructuredLogger.

Create agentwork/observability/metrics.py with MetricsCollector class: counter(name, value=1, tags=None), gauge(name, value, tags=None), histogram(name, value, tags=None). Stores metrics in memory. Methods: get_metrics() -> Dict, reset(). Also a decorator: @timed(metric_name) that records execution duration as histogram.

Create agentwork/observability/tracing.py with TraceContext class: trace_id (str, auto-generated), span_id (str, auto-generated), parent_span_id (Optional[str]). Context manager: with TraceContext() as ctx that sets up trace context. Utility: current_trace() that returns the active TraceContext (using contextvars).

Create agentwork/observability/exporters.py with Exporter ABC (export(data: List[dict])), ConsoleExporter (prints to stdout), FileExporter (appends JSON lines to a file). OTELExporter stub that formats metrics in OpenTelemetry-compatible JSON structure.
Create agentwork/observability/decorators.py with @instrument decorator that auto-instruments a function: creates a span, records duration metric, logs entry/exit, catches errors.

Create agentwork/server/rate_limiter.py with RateLimiter class using token bucket algorithm: constructor takes rate (float, tokens per second), capacity (int, max burst). Methods: allow(client_id: str) -> bool, get_retry_after(client_id: str) -> float. Also create add_rate_limit_middleware(app, rate, capacity, key_func) that adds FastAPI middleware returning 429 with Retry-After header when rate exceeded. key_func extracts client identity (default: X-API-Key header or client IP).
Create tests/test_cli.py: test argparse parsing for each subcommand, test list-companies output, test list-tools output.
Create tests/test_persistence.py: test SQLiteBackend save/get/list/delete for results and knowledge, test migration, test in-memory mode.
Create tests/test_observability.py: test StructuredLogger outputs JSON, test MetricsCollector counter/gauge/histogram, test TraceContext generates IDs, test @instrument decorator, test exporters.
Create tests/test_rate_limiter.py: test token bucket allows/denies correctly, test per-client tracking, test retry_after calculation.

Export key classes from agentwork/__init__.py: from persistence (StorageBackend, SQLiteBackend), from observability (StructuredLogger, MetricsCollector, TraceContext, instrument), from server (RateLimiter, WebSocketManager), CLI (just ensure the entry point works). Add all to __all__.
Update agentwork/server/__init__.py to export WebSocketManager and RateLimiter alongside create_app.
acceptance_criteria: CLI parses all subcommands correctly and list-companies/list-tools produce output
WebSocketManager manages connections and routes events by task_id
SQLiteBackend stores and retrieves task results and knowledge entries correctly
StructuredLogger produces JSON output with trace context
MetricsCollector tracks counters, gauges, and histograms
@instrument decorator records timing and handles errors
RateLimiter implements token bucket with per-client tracking
All new tests pass and all 268+ existing tests still pass
python3 -c 'import agentwork' succeeds with all new exports
verification: python3 -m pytest tests/test_cli.py tests/test_websocket.py tests/test_persistence.py tests/test_observability.py tests/test_rate_limiter.py -v
python3 -c 'from agentwork import StorageBackend, SQLiteBackend, StructuredLogger, MetricsCollector, TraceContext, instrument, RateLimiter, WebSocketManager, EventBus, LLMProvider, PluginManager'
findings: All 74 new tests pass. Full suite passes with 436 tests (up from 362). All imports verified successfully. The observability logger outputs to stderr (via logging.StreamHandler default), which is captured by capsys.readouterr().err in tests.
